Priya S.: 0.9.0 rolled out. Early adopters reported a safety filter regression where benign code completions occasionally truncated. Need to decide hotpatch vs schedule. Short: 1 P0 safety/regression, 2 P1 telemetry/billing, several enhancement asks from customers.
Tom B.: Tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.example/PRD-4200 (repro + failing orgs).
Izzy L.: Describe P0?
Priya S.: P0: safety classifier now flags end-of-snippet tokens leading to truncation; visible in REPL/codegen flows. Customer impact: mis-completions and confusing truncation.
Tom B.: That's product-critical. Suggest hotpatch to roll back classifier threshold change while we triage.
Izzy L.: Rolling back is fast if we keep the previous model variant available. I can flip routing and add a canary. ETA PR in 2 hours.
ops-bot: Deploy window: today 21:00 UTC. Patch branch: refs/heads/patch/0.9.1. Runbook: https://confluence.example/runbooks/0.9.1
Priya S.: Proposal: immediate hotpatch rollback for safety classifier in today's window; telemetry + billing fixes in 0.9.2; enhancements (per-route quant presets, prompt-tuning UI) to backlog.
Tom B.: Acceptance criteria for hotpatch: canary (5%) shows no truncations for 30m; error rate stable. If not met, rollback routing.
Izzy L.: Action items: @Izzy L. -> PR to flip routing + tests; @Tom B. -> canary alarms and synthetic regen suite; @Priya S. -> customer comms & roadmap note.
Priya S.: Also let's add a grooming session tomorrow to re-evaluate enhancements against early adopter feedback. 30m slot.
Tom B.: I'll move cards: hotpatch ticket, 0.9.2 backlog, grooming invite.
Izzy L.: Branch steps:
```
git checkout -b patch/0.9.1-safety-rollback
# revert classifier-threshold commit
git push origin patch/0.9.1-safety-rollback
```
Izzy L.: Will request expedited review.
Priya S.: Locking scope now. Hotfix = safety rollback + status update. 0.9.2 = telemetry/billing fixes. Backlog = UX & AP requests. Publish status update once canary green.
